metadata.question: Were there two isolated islands within a 2 km radius of (27.245974, 140.878144) on December 8, 2013, which had merged into a single island by March 30, 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point (27.245974, 140.878144) with 2km buffer - Dates: December 8, 2013 and March 30, 2014 - Collections: Landsat 8 (launched Feb 2013) for both dates, fallback to Landsat 7 if needed - Need to detect land/water boundaries to identify islands 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds to get clear water/land distinction - Use water indices (NDWI or water classification) or NIR/SWIR bands to distinguish water from land - Need to identify connected land components (islands) 3. Logic: - Valid scenario (A): Two separate islands in Dec 2013, one merged island in Mar 2014 - Valid scenario (B): Different pattern (not matching the question) - C1: No images found for either date - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after masking - C3: Calculation returns invalid results - Need to count distinct land masses using connected component analysis or visual inspection of land pixels ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([140.878144, 27.245974]); const roi = point.buffer(2000); // 2km radius const date1_start = '2013-12-01'; const date1_end = '2013-12-15'; const date2_start = '2014-03-23'; const date2_end = '2014-04-06'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Try Landsat 8 first let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Dec 2013 Landsat 8 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Mar 2014 Landsat 8 images: ${size2}`); // Fallback to Landsat 7 if needed if (size1 === 0) { col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); console.log(`Dec 2013 Landsat 7 images: ${col1.size().getInfo()}`); } if (size2 === 0) { col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); console.log(`Mar 2014 Landsat 7 images: ${col2.size().getInfo()}`); } if (col1.size().getInfo() === 0 || col2.size().getInfo() === 0) { console.log('No images found for one or both dates'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Processing - Cloud masking and water detection function maskCloudsAndGetWater(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qaMask.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) .and(qaMask.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); // Calculate NDWI: (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) const green = image.select('SR_B3').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const nir = image.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2); const ndwi = green.subtract(nir).divide(green.add(nir)); // Water is NDWI > 0, Land is NDWI <= 0 const land = ndwi.lt(0).updateMask(cloudMask); return land.rename('land'); } const img1 = col1.first(); const img2 = col2.first(); const land1 = maskCloudsAndGetWater(img1); const land2 = maskCloudsAndGetWater(img2); // Check valid pixels const count1 = land1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('land').getInfo(); const count2 = land2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('land').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid land pixels Dec 2013: ${count1}`); console.log(`Valid land pixels Mar 2014: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log('No valid land pixels after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 4. Connected component analysis to count islands const landSum1 = land1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('land').getInfo(); const landSum2 = land2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('land').getInfo(); console.log(`Total land pixels Dec 2013: ${landSum1}`); console.log(`Total land pixels Mar 2014: ${landSum2}`); // Use connectedPixelCount to identify separate islands const connected1 = land1.connectedPixelCount(100, false); const connected2 = land2.connectedPixelCount(100, false); // Count number of distinct island groups (components > threshold) const islands1 = connected1.gt(10).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.countDistinct(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('land').getInfo(); const islands2 = connected2.gt(10).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.countDistinct(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('land').getInfo(); console.log(`Island components Dec 2013: ${islands1}`); console.log(`Island components Mar 2014: ${islands2}`); if (islands1 === null || islands2 === null) { console.log('Island detection failed'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Check if pattern matches: 2 islands -> 1 island if (islands1 === 2 && islands2 === 1) { console.log('Pattern confirmed: Two islands merged into one'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Pattern does not match: ${islands1} -> ${islands2} islands`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
